technology_requirement: PartCue is new work started 20 October 2026. Devpost Learn's plan-lens skill shaped the design brief and preview acceptance criteria; the repo includes its devpost planning folder and exact skill-source revision. Snap's standalone CLAD SPECS experience-builder workflow built the actual project through the official Lens Studio MCP in Lens Studio 5.24.1. MCP operations created and saved the scene, compiled TypeScript, installed public packages, inspected runtime state and drove preview interactions. Spectacles Interaction Kit 2.0.0 and UIKit 2.0.0 provide real interaction targets and phase-specific UI. LEAF 2.0.2 verifies the experience: all seven functional/IK scenarios pass, including actual tray selection and confirmation with scripted fallback disabled. The shared TypeScript sequence core is byte-identical in the Lens and companion; 51 software checks and 12 Firebase emulator checks also pass in public CI. The hosted Firebase companion adds private saved jobs and manual custom-part records; it is separate from the Lens. Twelve live production smoke stages pass, including owner isolation, concurrent revisions, custom-job restoration and deletion-marker protection. The project uses the Default template configured for SPECS 27. The under-three-minute public demo shows actual native Lens Studio preview, four authored parts, predefined origins and explicit manual confirmations. The Lens project, packages, test evidence and planning are in the public repository. Created by Shivam Gupta with AI coding assistance.
where_stuck: In the delegated coding-agent workflow, account setup initially stalled: the CLAD router authorization probe stayed false after Snap sign-in, while the separate SPECS signup page returned 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' The standalone SPECS builder's project self-gate and official MCP public-package build tools subsequently worked; no signed-in Lens publishing authorization is claimed. In preview, UIKit targets could rebuild before an interaction released, and a back-row tray target was obscured along the IK ray. Deferring target rebuilding for four UpdateTicks and raising the back-row interaction target resolved those failures. A final adversarial review also found an older correct selection could remain armed after a wrong pick; an explicit deselection rule and live regression now prevent it. All seven Lens scenarios pass on the final saved revision. Native video capture needed to begin after LEAF reset the preview, because that reset stops an existing recording.
one_thing_to_fix: Make the account and authorization path explicit across Snap sign-in, SPECS accounts and CLAD. When the router reports isAuthorized=false, show which account is required, the current authorization state and the supported next action. A generic signup error plus a separate authorization failure made it difficult to distinguish an account problem from a local project/MCP setup problem.
